title.zh: 将罗哈斯市Tanza小学的名称正式变更为Mamerto Roxas法官纪念学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Tanza Primary School in the City of Roxas to Judge Mamerto Roxas Memorial School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Tanza Primary School in the City of Roxas to Judge Mamerto Roxas Memorial School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Tanza Primary School tại Thành phố Roxas thành Judge Mamerto Roxas Memorial School
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Tanza Primary School ในเมือง Roxas เป็น Judge Mamerto Roxas Memorial School
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Tanza Primary School di Kota Roxas menjadi Judge Mamerto Roxas Memorial School
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Tanza Primary School di Bandaraya Roxas menjadi Judge Mamerto Roxas Memorial School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5601_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Tanza Elementary School in the City of Roxas is hereby changed to Judge Mamerto Roxas Memorial School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
